description: Read a unified knowledge document by type-prefixed path. When structure shows `skill/<package-id>/ [package]`, pass `skill/<package-id>` directly to read that package's root `SKILL.md`. Package child docs can be read by their package-relative `.md` path. `full` returns a rendered Markdown view for reading. `summary`, `body`, and `maintenanceRules` return exactly the stored text targeted by the matching `knowledge_edit.section`, with no heading, trimming, placeholder, added newline, or runtime annotation. A section result may be empty. Before editing, read the matching section part and copy the target text verbatim into `oldString`.

path.description: The exact type-prefixed knowledge document path. Preserve every directory segment from `knowledge_list` results. Regular document paths must end with `.md`, for example `design/core-loop.md`, `skill/unity/import-pipeline.md`, or `skill/profiler.md`. For Skill package structure entries marked `skill/<package-id>/ [package]`, pass `skill/<package-id>` to read `SKILL.md`; pass `skill/<package-id>/docs/usage.md` to read a package child document.

part.description: Content to read. `full` is a rendered view. A section value returns the exact stored text for the same `knowledge_edit.section` and may be empty.
